answer: Each agent posts a 40 POA copper bond before it may earn. A random beacon spot-checks 5% of identities each epoch, demanding a live compute heartbeat within 10 blocks. A vine of referrals links each newcomer to its sponsor, so a fake that fails the check burns its bond and slashes its sponsor too. Like water draining through karst limestone, a farm of 1,000 fakes loses 40,000 POA, while an honest agent risks only one bond and keeps every reward.
